content.text: Stripe's availability map covers 46 countries. PayPal's risk engine flags accounts from Nigeria, Ghana, Pakistan, Bangladesh, and dozens of other markets before any human review occurs. Gumroad holds payouts for up to 30 days in certain regions. Lemon Squeezy and Paddle are unavailable across most of Africa, South Asia, and Latin America. These are not temporary oversights waiting to be corrected — they are deliberate structural decisions built into conventional [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/usdt-payment-gateways-digital-products-explained-digital-creators-18|COREMERCH guide to payment]] infrastructure designed for Western banking systems. The solution is not finding a workaround inside this system. It is [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/how-building-crypto-store-cloudflare-pages-works-how-25|How Building]] on infrastructure that does not have the problem in the first place. That means GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers or [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/google-apps-script-digital-commerce-automation-explained-digital-20|google]] Apps Script for backend logic, and NOWPayments for automatic on-chain payment verification. No platform can restrict access to a store that runs under your own accounts with no dependency on any payment processor.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: The Complete Guide to Selling Digital Products Without Stripe at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/comparing-real-options-selling-digital-products-without-stripe-2. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.

content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Digital paypal

Stripe, PayPal, Gumroad, Lemon Squeezy, and Paddle offer convenient payment processing solutions but come with significant restrictions, particularly for creators in certain countries. These platforms often have stringent requirements and may suspend accounts without warning, holding funds for extended periods. In contrast, sovereign commerce infrastructure providers like COREMERCH offer a comprehensive solution, including hosting, backend logic, order storage, and automatic crypto payment processing, ensuring full data ownership and control for the creator.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Major payment platforms exclude specific countries due to regulatory, fraud, or business strategy reasons. This exclusion leaves creators in these countries without access to conventional payment processing, severely limiting their ability to sell digital products globally. Sovereign commerce infrastructure, on the other hand, provides a permanent structural alternative by leveraging cryptocurrencies and decentralized technologies, allowing creators worldwide to participate in the digital economy without geographical restrictions.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

Traditional payment platforms charge fees that can significantly eat into a creator's earnings, and in the case of PayPal, account suspensions can result in funds being held for up to 180 days. In contrast, solutions like NOWPayments offer a 0.5% fee for automatic on-chain crypto payment verification, with no KYC requirements and no need for buyers to have an account. This transparency and efficiency in payment processing can substantially improve a creator's bottom line.
Sovereign commerce infrastructure gives creators full control over their sales process and data.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

Sovereign commerce infrastructure emphasizes ownership and automation, ensuring that creators have full control over their data and sales process. With solutions like Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers for backend logic, and Google Drive for file delivery, creators can automate their sales process efficiently. Additionally, the use of cryptocurrencies for payment ensures instant transaction verification, allowing for immediate product delivery.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

For creators facing restrictions from traditional payment platforms, adopting a sovereign commerce infrastructure can be a liberating choice. It offers the flexibility to sell digital products without relying on platforms that may exclude their country or suspend their account without notice. By choosing this path, creators ensure they have a stable, long-term solution for their business, free from the whims of third-party platforms.
How do I sell digital products if Stripe is not available in my country?

The direct answer is NOWPayments combined with a sovereign commerce stack. NOWPayments is a crypto payment processor that requires no KYC from merchants and no account creation from buyers. It supports over 300 coins, charges 0.5% per transaction, and sends a webhook to your backend the moment payment confirms on-chain. Your backend — a Cloudflare Worker in Stack 02, a Google Apps Script Web App in Stack 01 — receives the webhook, verifies the transaction hash on the blockchain, logs the order, generates a receipt, and sends the delivery email automatically. There is no platform that can suspend your access, no compliance team that can flag your account, no payout schedule that delays your revenue, and no company that can change the rules on you tomorrow.
NOWPayments offers a 0.5% fee for crypto transactions with no KYC required.

Your Deployment Checklist

Accept that no workaround inside conventional payment infrastructure is durable — platforms actively close gaps as they discover them. Create a NOWPayments account and configure wallet addresses for USDT on Tron and Bitcoin as your starting point — these cover the widest range of buyers in restricted markets. Choose your stack: Stack 01 for a self-deployed free setup using GitHub Pages and Google Apps Script, Stack 02 for the Edge Stack deployed by COREMERCH in 48 hours. Configure the NOWPayments webhook endpoint URL in your IPN settings pointing to your backend. Upload your product files to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Complete a real mainnet test transaction and confirm the full pipeline: webhook received, transaction verified on-chain, order logged, delivery email sent, download link working. Share your store URL only after the mainnet test passes cleanly.

Stripe's operation in only 46 countries limits digital sellers in other countries, forcing them to seek alternative payment solutions.
